name: Black Deuces
description: Black Deuces, also known as Deuces Wild, is a street gang founded in 1961 in the Cabrini Green public housing projects on Chicago's Near North Side. The gang was established by Richard "Champ" Strong, a co-founder of the Devil's Disciples, and was affiliated with the Black Disciple federation. Through the late 1960s and early 1970s the Deuces fought a violent war against the King Cobrastones (Cobra Stones) for control of Cabrini Green, during which two Chicago police officers were killed by snipers in July 1970. Larry Hoover connected with the Black Deuces to establish a heroin distribution ring in the projects around the same time. The gang was eventually absorbed into the Black Disciples (Gangster Disciples) after Richard Strong formed the civil rights front group B.L.A.C.K.S. in 1971, and maintained a presence in Cabrini Green until the projects were demolished by 2011.
